title: Perplexity Introduces AI 'Teammates' for Work Tasks
excerpt: Perplexity has launched personal AI agents designed to function as digital teammates for ongoing daily work assignments.
body_html:
Perplexity has introduced a new offering featuring personal AI agents described as 'teammates' designed to assist users with daily work tasks. These agents are built to function as ongoing participants in workplace activities, handling various operational assignments.

New AI Workplace Tools

The newly launched tools aim to integrate AI more deeply into daily professional routines by taking on continuous responsibilities. While specific implementation details and platform integrations remain limited, the feature marks the company's expansion into agentic AI assistants tailored for ongoing productivity needs.
